title: 環境材料学
subtitle: Environmental Materials
keywords: Materials science 2.Cement concrete 3.Mix proportion design 4.Steel, asphalt 5.Regional alliances
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) gain basic knowledge concerning materials science in order to design, construct, and maintain infrastructure appropriately while considering the environment of the region and the earth. (2) learn features of cement concrete, steel, and asphalt, which are primary construction materials. (3) learn methods for designing the mixture proportion of cement concrete.
advice: This is a basic course on construction materials. We will cover the following topics: 1. Features and classification of construction materials 2. Materials science: Chemical, electrical, thermal, dynamical characteristics 3. Cement concrete: Cement, admixtures, aggregate, concrete 4. Mixture proportions of cement concrete 5. Steel 6. Asphalt 7. New green materials: Recycling, local production for local consumption, maintenance Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class. This is useful preparation for Reinforced Concrete, Disaster prevention engineering, and Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises.[Please confirm course names.]

requiredKnowledge: Students must be familiar with the periodic table and chemical reaction formulae, as well as the concepts of density and the concentration of a solution

activityGoals.body: Students can scientifically explain character of construction material. [0.2D]
Students can explain the features, component materials, and main characteristics of cement concrete. [0.4J]
Students can calculate mixture proportions for cement concrete. [0.2J]
Students can explain the roles and features of steel and asphalt. [0.1J]
Students can explain reinforced concrete technologies that consider the environment of the region and the earth.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Fully explain the features and roles of various construction materials and select appropriate materials on site. (2) Design mixture proportions for cement concrete and master the process of its manufacture. (3) Direct reasonable methods for manufacturing cement concrete on site.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the features and roles of various construction materials. (2) Calculate mixture proportion for cement concrete and understand the process of its manufacture. (3) Assist in manufacturing cement concrete on site.

lessons.content: Guidance - Students understand what this subject will cover. - Students understand its relation to other subjects. Introduction - Students understand the possibility of extending the uses of materials. Materials science [1] - Students understand the chemical properties of construction materials.
lessons.assignments: Review features and classification of construction materials. Review classification of the materials. Memorize the first 20 atomic numbers in the periodic table. Review composition of chemical reaction formulae.

lessons.content: Materials science [2] - Students understand the physical, thermal (specific heat, thermal conductivity, etc.) and dynamical (void ratio, stress, strain, etc.) properties of construction materials.
lessons.assignments: Review material science. Prepare outline of cement concrete

lessons.content: Overview of cement concrete Quiz [1] (15%) - covers 1st and 2nd classes
lessons.assignments: Review material science. Prepare outline of cement concrete
Review types of cement and admixtures. Prepare for aggregate.
Review characteristics of aggregate. Think about environmental effects of using aggregate. Prepare for fresh concrete.

lessons.content: Cement concrete [1] - Students understand fresh performance of concrete and concrete for which notes are necessary for construction. Quiz [2] (15%) - covers 3rd-5th classes
lessons.assignments: Review for performance of fresh concrete. Prepare for hardened concrete.

lessons.content: Cement concrete [2] - Students understand dynamical and durable performance of hardened concrete.
lessons.assignments: Review dynamical and durable performance of hardened concrete. Prepare for design of mixture proportion.
Review design of mixture proportion. Prepare for design of mixture proportion.
Review design of mixture proportions. Prepare for steel.
Review steel. Prepare for polymers, asphalt, and green materials.

lessons.content: Polymers Asphalt Green materials - Maintenance, Recycle, Reuse
